title: How a SIP works: compounding, time and rupee-cost averaging
short: How a SIP works: compounding, time and averaging
dek: Indians put a record ₹32,490 crore into SIPs in September, even as fund assets fell. The three ideas behind the monthly habit, with the maths, and what it can't do.
card: ₹10,000 a month for 25 years: ₹30 lakh in, about ₹1.9 crore out at 12%. How SIP maths works, and where it breaks.
